messages.subject: ggvis circular examples
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm trying to make something similar to the genome viewer <https://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/genome-browser.html> in the shiny gallery, and I'm struggling on how to code up circular ggvis elements. Are there any example posts of circularising ggvis layers that I've missed? If not could I request some examples be made available?

Thanks for the great library!

Andrew
